26. INSTALL FLANGES, PLATES AND DISCS OF OVERDRIVE
BRAKE

(a) Install the 4.0 mm (0.157 in.) thick flange (flat ring)
with the rounded edge side of the flange facing the
disc.

(b) Install the plates and discs.
Install in order: P = Plate D = Disc
7M-GE:    D—P—D—P—D—P—D
7M-GTE: D—P—D—P—D—P—D—P—D

(c) Install the flange (stepped ring) with the flat side of
the flange facing the disc.

(d) Install the snap ring.
